title: Skin Care for Vijayawada Weather: A Routine for Extreme Heat, Two Rainy Seasons and Mild Winters
ex: Fierce summer heat, a humid monsoon, cyclone rains and a short mild winter: a simple, season-by-season skin care routine for people living in Vijayawada.
rt: Skin Care for Vijayawada Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Vijayawada weather: sun care and light layers for extreme summer heat, monsoon and cyclone-season tips and a richer routine for mild winters.
quick: Vijayawada is hot, and often humid, from March to November, with rain from June to September and more in October and November. Use a gentle face wash, a thin gel moisturiser and broad-spectrum sunscreen every day, and add a creamier moisturiser and full night cream only from December to February.
facts: Vijayawada is inland on the Krishna river, without the sea breeze of the coast
March to early June brings some of the hottest days in Andhra Pradesh
Rain comes from the south-west monsoon and from Bay of Bengal systems in October and November
December to February is mild and drier
